The graph format changes (72); the first start after the upgrade rebuilds the graph.

## Tools

- **`detect_changes`** pages `changed_symbols` with `offset` together with the dependents, and `next_offset` stays while either list has more, so a change of more than 1000 symbols can be read in full. The text counts only what the page holds and names the next offset.
- **`find_callers`** lists under `undecided_callers` the refused bare calls from Swift to an Objective-C definition, and from a Go package that imports the definition's package with `.`.

## Resolution

- A file a SCIP index covers records the language its content names, so an Objective-C `.m` file there no longer reads as Matlab.

## Install

- Homebrew: `brew install attackwave/glasir/glasir`
- Scoop: add the bucket `Attackwave/scoop-glasir`, then run `scoop install glasir`
